mutation.reason: Diagnoses indicate repeated tool execution failures (tool_runtime) and premature termination due to evidence verifier blocks. The current recovery policy is disabled or too conservative (max_text_failures=1, density=10s). Increasing the failure tolerance to 3, extending coverage density to 30s to capture more context, and allowing up to 2 recovery calls will enable the system to retry Inspect_Frame with broader temporal windows after initial failures, addressing the 'tool execution' and 'evidence verifier' root causes without violating bounded constraints.

proposal.expected_effect: The system will automatically trigger Inspect_Frame with a 30-second density window up to 3 times when initial text-based retrieval or narrow temporal probes fail, increasing the likelihood of acquiring valid visual evidence to satisfy the evidence verifier and prevent premature termination.
proposal.regression_risk: Low. The policy is bounded (max 3 failures, 2 calls, 30s density) and only activates on low-signal temporal grounding failures. It does not alter tool schemas or introduce new backends.

active_tool_schemas.name: Segment_Retrieve
active_tool_schemas.description: Retrieve a segment's preprocessed evidence bundle by segment ID or time range. Returns caption, transcript, timestamps, cached frame images, and optional graph entities.

segment_id.description: Segment identifier. Supports raw IDs like '7' and composite IDs like 'example_7'.

time_range.description: Time range to match (e.g. '30-60' or '00:01:00-00:02:00'). Intersects with segment_id filters when both are provided.

fields.description: Which fields to return. Allowed values: ['caption', 'transcript', 'graph', 'frame_times', 'frame_paths']. May be provided as a list or comma-separated string.

active_tool_schemas.name: Semantic_Retrieve
active_tool_schemas.description: Perform fuzzy semantic retrieval based on natural language description. Returns the retrieved segment's preprocessed evidence bundle, including caption, transcript, timestamps, and cached frame images. Supports time-range constraints. Dense visual-only matches are returned as unverified candidates and are not cited as answer evidence until Inspect_Frame or Video_Clip_QA confirms them. Each candidate also exposes its full executable probe window; verify that window before narrowing to a short timestamp.

active_tool_schemas.name: Video_Clip_QA
active_tool_schemas.description: Comprehensive short-window video understanding tool. Clip the requested start/end window first, then send that clip file directly to the local VLM and answer open-ended or ambiguous questions about the clip, including actions, interactions, temporal order, scene changes, object states, counts, comparisons, and overall visual events. Prefer this broad fallback when the request needs holistic reasoning over a short video segment instead of only OCR, single frames, tracking, or a narrow specialized visual probe.

query.description: Question to answer from the clipped video

segment_id.description: Optional segment reference. If provided, segment-relative start/end times will be converted to full-video absolute times.
